title: Beyond Discrimination: Evaluating Probability Calibration in Radiomics-Image Fusion for Renal Cell Carcinoma Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.14151v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reliable probability estimates are important for the clinical interpretation of machine-learning classifiers, yet radiomics--image fusion models for renal cell carcinoma (RCC) are commonly evaluated primarily by discrimination. Using 396 patients from the KiTS23 dataset, we evaluated whether adding radiomics to four image-model families improved probabilistic performance in addition to discrimination. Seventeen individual models and four probability-average ensembles were assessed using discrimination, probability calibration, and proper scoring measures. Across 12 matched image-only versus fusion comparisons, AUC and AP improved in all 12, while Brier score and negative log likelihood (NLL) improved in 11 of 12 and expected calibration error (ECE) in eight of 12. translated_title: 超越判别能力：评估肾细胞癌分类中影像组学-图像融合的概率校准
translated_abstract: 可靠的概率估计对于机器学习分类器的临床解读非常重要，然而用于肾细胞癌（RCC）的影像组学-图像融合模型通常主要以判别能力进行评估。我们使用KiTS23数据集中的396名患者，评估了在四种图像模型家族中加入影像组学是否能在提升判别能力之外同时改善概率性能。研究共评估了17个单独模型和4个概率平均集成模型，采用判别指标、概率校准指标和恰当评分指标。在12组匹配的仅图像模型与融合模型的对比中，AUC和AP在全部12组中均有改善，Brier分数和负对数似然（NLL）在12组中的11组有改善，期望校准误差（ECE）在12组中的8组有改善。3D MedVAE门控融合模型在所有单独模型中取得了最佳的综合表现。跨拼接、交叉注意力和门控融合的概率平均方法产生了（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究首次系统评估了肾细胞癌分类中影像组学-图像融合模型的概率校准性能，发现融合模型不仅在全部12组对比中提升了判别指标AUC和AP，还在大多数情况下改善了校准指标，其中3D MedVAE门控融合模型综合表现最佳。
en_tdlr: This study systematically evaluates probability calibration in radiomics-image fusion models for renal cell carcinoma classification, showing that fusion improved AUC and AP in all 12 matched comparisons and calibration metrics in most cases, with the 3D MedVAE gated-fusion model achieving the strongest overall performance.
